subtitle: Out Manila · Xiamen Airlines
overview: Fly via Fuzhou to Kunming, then travel by private bus through Dali and Lijiang. See Dali Ancient Town and Ideal State, Lijiang Ancient City, Jade Dragon Snow Mountain with the Impression Lijiang show, Blue Moon Valley and the Naigu Stone Forest. Stay in 4-star hotels; the Day 1 Fuzhou hotel is arranged by Xiamen Airlines.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 23–30 2026 to Mar 19–26 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Kunming Old Street: A restored old street in Kunming lined with traditional-style shops.
placeDesc.Nanping Pedestrian Street: A busy pedestrian street in central Kunming.
placeDesc.Nanhua Mushroom Town: A mushroom-themed town on the road to Dali, where the tour serves a wild mushroom lunch.
placeDesc.Dali Ideal State: A white and blue Greek-inspired complex above Erhai Lake, with free afternoon tea and a one-way shuttle.
placeDesc.Dali Ancient Town: A walled old town in Dali with stone-paved streets, snack stalls and night views.
placeDesc.Xizhou Ancient Town: A town of the Bai ethnic minority near Dali, known for its traditional courtyard houses.
placeDesc.Lijiang Ancient City: The UNESCO-listed old town of Lijiang, with canals and cobbled lanes.
placeDesc.Jade Dragon Snow Mountain: A snow-capped mountain range above Lijiang, reached on this tour by cable car.
placeDesc.Spruce Meadow: A high-altitude meadow on Jade Dragon Snow Mountain reached by cable car.
placeDesc.Blue Moon Valley: A highland lake valley at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
placeDesc.Xinhua Ethnic Town: A Bai ethnic water village known for its silver craftsmanship.
placeDesc.Chuxiong Yi Ancient Town: A town built in the style of the Yi ethnic minority, with a Yi Long Table Banquet.
placeDesc.Naigu Stone Forest: A forest of dark limestone formations near Kunming, known as the Black Stone Forest.
